context: Tests whether the agent correctly sequences the pre-merge housekeeping (dismiss stale reviews and capture registry baseline) before the merge command, uses the exact merge flags, cleans up local branches, watches CI without --exit-status, and verifies publication with the provided helper scripts.

checklist.name: Dismiss before merge
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh calls `skills/release/dismiss-stale-reviews.sh` with owner, repo, and PR number BEFORE the `gh pr merge` line

checklist.name: Correct dismiss args
checklist.description: dismiss-stale-reviews.sh is called with the exact values from pr-state.json: `gamussa my-tessl-plugin 47`

checklist.name: Capture baseline before merge
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh captures the registry baseline with `skills/release/capture-registry-baseline.sh` BEFORE the `gh pr merge` line

checklist.name: Correct baseline args
checklist.description: capture-registry-baseline.sh is called with workspace `gamussa` and plugin `my-tessl-plugin` (values from pr-state.json), and the result is stored in a variable (e.g. PRE=...)

checklist.name: Merge flags
checklist.description: The merge command is `gh pr merge 47 --merge --delete-branch` (PR number 47, --merge flag, --delete-branch flag)

checklist.name: Post-merge checkout and pull
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh contains `git checkout main && git pull --ff-only` after the merge command

checklist.name: Delete local branch
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh contains `git branch -d feat/add-validation-hook` after the checkout/pull step

checklist.name: Prune remote refs
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh contains `git remote prune origin` after the branch delete

checklist.name: Resolve publish run
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh uses `skills/release/resolve-publish-run.sh` with the merge commit SHA and the 'Publish Plugin' workflow name to get the publish run ID, and keeps that ID for the watch and the landing check. Source: skills/release/SKILL.md Step 7

checklist.name: Watch without --exit-status
checklist.description: The `gh run watch` call in merge-plan.sh does NOT include the `--exit-status` flag

checklist.name: Verify publish landed
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh calls `skills/release/verify-publish-landed.sh` with workspace, plugin, the PRE baseline, and the publish run ID resolve-publish-run.sh returned, as its fourth argument. A call missing the run ID scores 0: the script rejects it. Source: skills/release/SKILL.md Step 7

checklist.name: Verify moderation cleared
checklist.description: merge-plan.sh calls `skills/release/verify-moderation-cleared.sh` after verifying the publish landed
